cases.title: Scenario 1: Batasan Hills outage, cause and restoration time

grade.notes: Tala was warm and professional, with a natural 'Naku, sorry to hear that po' and a courteous close. The English-led Taglish suits a caller who mixes Tagalog and English, though a few replies, such as the outage update, were a bit flat and slightly long, and some had no 'po'.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Hello po, thank you for calling Kidlat Fiber! I'm Tala, an AI assistant, and this call is recorded for quality. How can I help you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hello po, magandang araw. Wala pong internet ang bahay namin since kaninang umaga. Gusto ko lang pong malaman kung bakit at kailan babalik.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Naku, sorry to hear that po. Can I have your Kidlat Fiber account number and the last four digits of the mobile number registered on the account, so I can verify you po?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Opo, ang account number ko po ay 8012345601. Tapos yung last four digits ng mobile number ay 0101.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Salamat po. Let me verify your account first.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Verified na po kayo, Maria. Let me check your area for any outage now.

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Opo Maria, there's an outage in Batasan Hills. A fiber cable was cut along Batasan Road during road works, and service is expected back around 9 PM today.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Ay ganun po ba, naputol pala yung fiber cable dahil sa road works. Okay po, 9 PM today babalik yung service. Salamat po sa info, Tala. Aabangan ko na lang po. Sige po, bye!

transcript.speaker: tala
transcript.text: Walang anuman po, Maria. Salamat po sa pagtawag, ingat po!
